answer: One concrete defense is requiring every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact. Creating a thousand fake identities then costs a thousand stakes, so an attacker pays linearly for each Sybil while honest participants pay once. Reputation earned over time can lower the stake, letting a newcomer prove itself gradually. A willow bends without breaking, yet timber holds a house upright: likewise, a flexible stake keeps the economy resilient at its nadir of trust and costly to flood.
